newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end on new life high, eye 1,300.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end on new life high, eye 1,300.

text.p: Austrian shares stormed 1.55 percent higher to end on a new life high of 1,290.11, propelled by oil and chemicals group OMV, traders said and forecast the index could make a stab at 1,300 in the next days.
"We advanced on a broad front," said one trader, noting international markets had given support to Vienna.
"The blue chips went really very well," said another.
Steelmakers VA Stahl and Boehler, engineering group VA Tech, regional utility EVN and OMV registered solid gains.
However, while most traders put 1,300 as the next target, some warned profittaking could set in.
"Clients are already beginning to buy puts," said one.
The ATX blue chip index ended at 1,290.11, off the intraday high of 1,297.99 points. Among its constituents 17 shares rose, two fell and two were unchanged.
The day's leading gainer was microchip maker AMS climbing 3.68 percent to 930 schillings.
Luxury hosiery maker Wolford led the decliners, dropping 2.28 percent to 1,241 schillings.
The June ATX future added 20 points to end at 1,289.0. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
